name: BIDS Tracula (under development)
summary: Reconstructs major white matter pathways with FreeSurfer TRACULA (bids/tracula v6.0.0-4 BIDS App) from a T1-weighted image, DWI and an optional FreeSurfer directory.
description: Arranges the T1w and DWI inputs into a one-subject BIDS dataset and runs the bids/tracula BIDS App (FreeSurfer 6 TRACULA, all stages) on it, reusing an existing FreeSurfer subject directory when given. The App is marked as under development. It needs a FreeSurfer license and can take up to a day of compute.

inputs.description: Optional FreeSurfer subject directory for the same subject; passed to TRACULA with --freesurfer_dir so recon-all is not rerun.

outputs.description: TRACULA output directory for the subject as produced by the bids/tracula App.
